updates.allIgnored: No pending updates — everything else is ignored.
updates.noneActionable: Nothing here can be updated by Canager
updates.newBuild: A newer build of this model is available
updates.noneCheckable: No updates in the sources Canager could check

commandPreview.label: This will run:
commandPreview.needsPassword: This will ask for your Mac password.

warnings.dependentsUnknown: Canager couldn't check what depends on this, so removing it might break other software.
warnings.compilesLocally: This will compile locally and can take several minutes.
warnings.nonRegistrySource: This wasn't installed from crates.io, so Canager can't check it for updates.

pipReadOnly.title: Read-only: pip packages
pipReadOnly.description: Canager can only show what's installed with pip, not update or uninstall it. Install Python command-line tools with pipx or uv instead to manage them here.

prefixNotWritable.title: Read-only: npm packages
prefixNotWritable.description: Canager can list these but can't update or remove them: npm keeps them in a folder your account isn't allowed to change. That usually means Node was installed with the installer from nodejs.org. Installing Node with Homebrew instead lets Canager manage them.

unreachable.title: Canager can't reach {{source}} right now
unreachable.description: {{source}} is installed but didn't answer. Below is what Canager saw last time; anything added or removed since then won't show up. Reopening Canager usually fixes this.

ollamaNotRunning.title: Ollama isn't running
ollamaNotRunning.description: Start the Ollama app to see its models and check for updates.

notRunning.title: {{source}} isn't running
notRunning.description: Start {{source}}, then come back — Canager will list what's in it.

indexMayBeStale.title: “Up to date” may not be accurate for Homebrew
indexMayBeStale.description: Canager couldn't download Homebrew's latest list of software, so there may be updates it can't see yet. Check your internet connection, then try again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.description: Review what this will do before you continue.
uninstall.planError: Couldn't check what this would affect: {{message}}
uninstall.affectedTitle: These will stop working if you remove it:
uninstall.confirmDisabledHint: Resolve the items above before uninstalling.

settings.title: Settings

showTechnicalDetails.label: Show technical details
showTechnicalDetails.description: Reveal version numbers, file paths, and the exact commands Canager runs.

includeSelfUpdating.label: Include self-updating apps
includeSelfUpdating.description: List apps that update themselves, like Chrome and Docker, as updatable here too.

settings.saveError: Couldn't save that change ({{message}}). It's been reverted.

noSources.title: Nothing for Canager to manage yet
noSources.description: Canager works with Homebrew, npm, pipx, uv, pip, Cargo and Ollama. None of them are set up on this Mac yet — Homebrew is the easiest place to start.

refusedAsRoot.title: Canager can't run as an administrator
refusedAsRoot.description: Homebrew refuses to run under the root user for safety. Quit Canager, then open it again from your normal user account.

refreshFailed.title: Some data might be out of date
refreshFailed.description_one: The last refresh couldn't finish for {{count}} source, so what you see below may be stale.
refreshFailed.description_other: The last refresh couldn't finish for {{count}} sources, so what you see below may be stale.

nothingInstalled.title: Nothing installed yet
nothingInstalled.description: Anything you install with Homebrew, npm, pipx, uv, pip, Cargo or Ollama will show up here.
